Lungsod Pasay at Paranaque naman ang pinuntahan ng Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) ngayong araw para sa anti-illegal parking and illegal terminal operation.

Partikular na tinungo ng grupo ang Nichols, Roxas Blvd., at Heritage na pawang nasa Pasay habang Quirino Ave. naman sa Paranaque.

Apatnapu't anim ang nahuli sa pamamagitan ng non-contact apprehension habang walo naman ang sa physical apprehension dahil sa mga violation gaya ng hindi pagsunod sa dress code kapag nagmomotor.

data.text:
Hmmm...the game continues.
As Trump jets through Asia like a sovereignty samurai (Malaysia → Japan → SKorea, wrapping with Xi in Seoul), headlines are screamimg "trade deals!" But peel back the unipolar onion, and it's a masterclass in dismantling the vampire cabal: IMF/World Bank/BIS bloodsuckers who' have chained the Global South for decades. 

Trump's not "containing China" – he's torching the globalist fairy tale, forcing bilateral awakenings that sideline the Davos debt-trap. Like Abacha said: Audit the ghosts, seize the refineries. Now watch it ripple. 

MALAYSIA: Lands in KL, brokers Thailand-Cambodia border pact, inks US trade deal under Anwar's watch. But Malaysians are whining– "Anwar sold us out to Uncle Sam!" Critics torch him for $240B commitments, sovereignty swaps, and "subservient" tariffs that allegedly lock Malaysia into US orbit. 
Anwar fires back: "Sovereignty intact, best-case scenario!" But shade's thick – opposition calls it elite favoritism, anti-corruption betrayal. 
Trump's play? Bilateral bait: Quick wins for Malaysia (tariff hedges, tech transfers) that expose Anwar's globalist leanings. If Anwar folds harder, public revolt could flip him pro-BRICS. 
Multipolar pivot incoming? 

JAPAN HANDOFF: Tokyo's all smiles on "trade imbalances & military alliances," but Trump's whispering sweet nothings: "Move factories home, or eat 25% tariffs." 😅
Japan – that post-WWII US vassal – squirms as Trump exploits their China fears. Rare earths? Locked. Auto exports? Crippled unless they ditch Beijing's orbit. 
It's Monroe 2.0 for Asia: Bilateral bows over multilateral chains. 

Globalists are boiling 😂 – EU's already flooding with "green regs" to counter. 

But Trump's move: Force Japan/SKorea into US bloc, isolate CCP supply chains. No more "friendshoring" for the vampires. 

THE KOREA CLIMAX: "Final" stop, $450B US-SKorea deal teed up, deficit slashed, Xi summit looming.

Taiwan (the ghost in the room) – FM Lin downplays "abandonment fears," yet aides whisper Trump's waffling: "Stable ties, but no blank checks." Xi wants a "truce" on chips/Taiwan; Trump dangles tariffs for concessions. 

Move: Use SKorea/Japan as wedges – arm them up, tariff-proof them, but dangle Taiwan ambiguity to flush CCP aggression. If Xi blinks (rare earths flow resumes?), Taiwan breathes. 
If not? Multipolar alliances harden – India/Philippines/Vietnam step up. No more U.S as global cop...

We're going to need more data...
